## Public question

What needs clarification? Include applicability and uncertainty, not a claimed conclusion.

## Candidate public sources

Original URL, exact version and verified locator if already read. Do not invent citations or upload restricted full papers.

## Related K/S-IDs

List existing stable IDs and relevant conditions, if any.

## Review needed

Describe missing evidence, reproduction status, differing conditions or potential conflict. Do not automatically decide which claim is true.

Public content only: no private conversations, contacts, job records, trading parameters/positions, account details or credentials.
